entries.capability: RAII and the free path for a kernel handle
entries.finding: refcount 1 -> 2 on copy -> 1 after Nullify; every kernel handle in the bridge is a local Handle that dies at scope exit

entries.capability: invalid inputs are rejected with a reason, no partial result
entries.finding: 9/9 invalid cases rejected: 7 by the bridge guard before the kernel, 2 by OCCT (huge -> BRep_Builder::Infinite parameter, tiny -> Standard_DomainError); all carry a message and the process survives
10 000 cycles in 0.73 s; working set 10 805 248 B -> 11 223 040 B, growth 0.398 MiB (allocator cache level, not per-shape growth)

entries.capability: thread serialization policy and UI handoff
entries.finding: 1000 calls from 4 threads through one mutex: 0 wrong results in 0.41 s; 100 independent calls (no mutex) also succeeded in 0.013 s, recorded as an observation, not as a thread-safety promise

policy.kernel_calls: one at a time, marshalled through the application layer (mutex)
policy.ui_handoff: the UI thread never calls the kernel directly; it posts a request and the response is applied on the UI thread
policy.rationale: OCCT 8 keeps its error-handler stack thread_local, but the toolkits do not promise arbitrary concurrent mutation of shared shapes
